frontmatter.title: VQE: vary a state to lower its energy
frontmatter.description: An explicit two-qubit variational ansatz, an independently checked energy, and complete optimization and measurement accounting.

children.value: VQE uses a classical optimizer to choose the parameters of a quantum state-preparation circuit. Each proposed state is prepared repeatedly, its Hamiltonian terms are measured, and the estimated energy becomes the optimizer’s objective
. A short preparation circuit does not by itself determine the cost of finding good parameters: all proposals, measurement groups, shots, and classical work belong to the workflow.

children.value: The ansatz determines which states can be reached. Optimization can reduce energy only within that family, and finding its global minimum is a separate problem. Our small example chooses a family whose exact energy is easy to check. It establishes no general convergence guarantee or quantum advantage.

This historical projection concerns the first two-qubit Hamiltonian

maps every initial call, incumbent remeasurement, accepted or rejected proposal, and holdout to an explicit measured circuit. The VQE task has 579,072 preparations and 588 all-Z/all-X batches. These are modeled repetitions of stored circuits, not predictions of a fresh hardware-driven adaptive path.
These are the unchanged VQE rows from the original replay, not a new estimate. Each task retains its separate whole-task physical-fault allowance
. The scalar is a coherent approximation-model quantity and is not summed over shots as a stochastic failure probability. Profiles retain physical error

Times sum every preparation’s model runtime; peaks take the maximum of independently selected class footprints. A common physical configuration is not verified. Physical initialization/reset, transport, routing, reconfiguration, communication and adaptive feedback remain unmeasured or excluded. The PSSPC rotation fit supplies expected resource cost, not concrete synthesized sequences, worst-case bounds, runtime-tail guarantees, or an output-accuracy certificate. CPU controller, reference and simulator times remain separate.

The larger shared size-study replay also retains all 72 runs and 5,859,840 preparations, including every quality miss. Its 84 cost classes and 85 searches remain a separate frozen record with independently selected class configurations. They are not a time-to-quality estimate or a physical proxy for the later initialization diagnostics, which have no new physical projection.

Independent checks compare explicit circuits with classical references, preserve preparation and measurement maps, and replay recorded sampled decisions from their counts. The finite-shot protocol’s fresh holdout bounds concern selected fixed states conditional on their training histories; they do not certify adaptive training queries, convergence, or physical hardware. Circuit export and bounded classical simulation have separate limits.

The reproduced Lean artifact establishes finite C4 cut values and the stated classical equality predicate. It does not connect those definitions to Python or prove QAOA circuits, VQE ansätze, stochastic decisions, synthesis, physical schedules, or hardware confidence.
